item.title: This Day In Dodgers History: Orel Hershiser Takes Pay Cut Through Arbitration For 1987 Season
item.description: On February 7, 1987, Orel Hershiser signed with the Los Angeles Dodgers for $800,000, taking a pay cut of 20% from his previous season’s salary.
